limitations: STEP 1 packaging/privacy review only; no numerical, fixed-checker, resource-limit, broader A2 accounting, scientific, protocol-freeze, commit/push or release approval.

Privacy coverage is the explicit 100-file public closure and recursive archive bodies with bounded parsed fields, observed token/base64 and selected credential patterns; it is not universal secret detection or clearance for later changed files.
Historical manifests and failed verdicts remain unchanged and may reference omitted receipts; the derivative intentionally lacks complete historical replay closure.

Portable verification relies on an externally trusted inventory hash and owner-controlled nonconcurrent paths, not hostile concurrent-filesystem safety or authentication after replacing both inventory and trust pin.

Archived test-run records were checked for byte, source, XML, count and exit consistency, not independently attested historical OS/process execution. New copied packaging, CLI and tamper checks were actually executed.
Reviewer harness setup/schema errors are preserved separately from successful reruns; no candidate source or evidence was repaired.
post_review_constraints: Publication/progress wording only in named paths; separately indexed review/final-QA records. No protected source/evidence changes.
